note: Common behavioral and HR interview questions with STAR guidance. Theme keywords (prefix-matched) check that an answer addresses the question.

questions.question: Tell me about a time you worked as part of a team to achieve a goal.
tips: Make your own contribution clear, not just the team's.
Mention how you coordinated or communicated.

questions.question: Describe a disagreement with a teammate and how you resolved it.
tips: Stay neutral about the other person.
Focus on how you listened and reached agreement.

questions.question: Tell me about a time something you worked on failed. What did you learn?
tips: Own the mistake honestly.
Spend most of the answer on what you changed afterwards.

questions.question: Describe a time you had to meet a tight deadline.
tips: Explain how you prioritised.
Say what was delivered and when.

questions.question: Tell me about a time you had to learn a new skill or technology quickly.
tips: Describe how you learned, not only what.
Show how you applied it.

questions.question: Give an example of when you took initiative without being asked.
tips: Explain what you noticed and why it mattered.
Describe the impact of your action.

questions.question: Tell me about a time you led a group or took responsibility for others.
tips: Leadership can be informal (a project, club or class group).
Describe how you supported others.

questions.question: Describe a time you received critical feedback. How did you respond?
tips: Show openness rather than defensiveness.
Explain what you changed as a result.

questions.question: How do you handle stress or several tasks at the same time? Give an example.
tips: Describe a concrete method (lists, priorities, breaking work down).
Give a real example.

questions.question: Tell me about the most difficult problem you solved. How did you approach it?
tips: Walk through your reasoning step by step.
Mention alternatives you considered.

questions.question: Why are you interested in an internship in this field?
tips: Connect your interest to real experiences or projects.
Say what you hope to learn.

questions.question: What are your main strengths and one area you are working to improve?
tips: Support each strength with an example.
Choose a genuine area for improvement and how you are working on it.
